title: Height-bounded video stage width collapses to zero or a sliver on short viewports such as landscape phones
test: tests/browser/ui-semantics.spec.mjs: 'the host video stage keeps its minimum width on a 844x390 landscape phone', '... 667x375 ...', and the two matching 'the watch video stage keeps its minimum width on a ...' tests (chromium project); 'the host and watch video stages are unchanged at 1440x900' and '... at 1366x768' pin the unchanged desktop widths
proof: Before the fix (vite build of the unchanged src/index.css, served by server.js on 3210) all four landscape-phone tests failed at the minimum-width assertion (expected >= 287.5, the 18rem floor): host stage width 2px (the borders only, content width 0) at both 844x390 and 667x375, watch stage width 152.9px at 844x390 and 126.2px at 667x375. After the fix the stage is 288px on both pages at both sizes, 16:9, never wider than its container. The two desktop tests passed before and after the change: 1440x900 host 720px (capped by the section), watch 820.8px (60% cap); 1366x768 host 625.8px (height term), watch 778.6px (60% cap). ui-semantics.spec.mjs: 47 passed, 13 skipped (mobile-chrome skips), exit 0.
